prompt:
Repaint this ink painting of a harbour at dusk in a far more reduced, freehand manner. The first reference image is the current background of the game: keep its composition exactly, the place and the size of the cottage with its chimney on the left, the jetty with its posts and the two boats, the rocky headland with the white lighthouse, its red band and the small house on the right, the lantern post, the barrels, the crates and the rope at the back edge of the quay, the line of the quay, the horizon and the far hills. Only the brushwork changes: reduce everything to a few large wet washes. The second reference image is a study sheet of the brush marks of the game: paint with the same brush and the same ink, but do not copy any of its marks.

Technique: boneless freehand ink painting (xieyi, mokkotsu) on warm off-white rice paper: every object is one to five large wet washes laid with the side of a big soft brush, without contour lines and without drawn details. The cottage is one dark wet wash for the roof (no shingles, no tiles), one pale wash for the walls (no stones) and one dark dab for the chimney; the window a small spot of bare paper. Each boat is one curved dark stroke for the hull and one thin stroke for the mast, no rigging; the jetty a few dark vertical dabs for the posts and one pale horizontal stroke, no planks. The headland is one big wet splash of ink that bleeds into the paper at its edges and fades into mist below, no individual rocks, no bushes, no grass; the lighthouse two vertical strokes and a small dark cap, with the red band as one flat wash of vermilion. The stone quay is one long pale grey horizontal stroke with a darker dry-brush edge along the water, no individual stones, no paving; the barrels two dark blots with one paler stroke each, no hoops, no staves; the crates two or three square dabs of grey, no planks, no nails; the rope one curling stroke; the lantern post one thin vertical stroke with a small dark dab for the lantern. Wet washes have soft feathered edges and slightly darker rims where they dried; a few strokes break into dry-brush streaks with flecks of white paper. Strong contrast between a few very dark accents and pale washes. Large areas stay untouched paper: the sky, the water, the mist and the front of the quay. Black ink only; the single exception in the whole painting is the red band of the lighthouse. Not a detailed ink-and-wash illustration, no hatching, no texture, no fine lines, not a pen drawing, not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a digital painting, not a postcard, no orange or yellow anywhere, no seal stamps, no calligraphy, no frame or border.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Important for the game version: some things move in the game and are added later as separate animated layers, so paint them exactly as described here, even where the description above says otherwise. No smoke at all above the chimney: the chimney top stands clean against the empty paper. The lighthouse lamp only as a small spot of bare paper inside the dark lantern room, without any beam, rays or halo. The lit window and the lantern only as small spots of bare paper. The band of light at the horizon is a strip of bare paper, not orange; above it the sky is bare paper with a very pale grey wash that becomes slightly darker towards the top, with only one or two pale horizontal wash streaks near the horizon as clouds; no stars, no moon. The water is bare paper with only a few short horizontal dry-brush strokes and pale reflections of the boats. Pale mist lies over the far water and around the foot of the headland. No birds.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
